mentions.name: openbot
mentions.description: An open source platform that combines AI bots with the actor model, functioning as an alternative to Grok Bot. It offers a self-hosted version where users can run multiple bots that talk to each other.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an open source platform similar to Grok Bot: https://github.com/regnull/openbot

Think of it as a synthesis of AI bots and actor model. For now I have a self hosted version where you can run a bunch of bots talking to each other.
mentions.author: regnull
